project: compass-navigator-6ff82a9e (ROUT profile hub) -> this Lovable project

source.note: Public repository cloned into a temporary folder and inspected read-only. No .env exists in the repository (gitignored); no secret values were copied.

decisions.decision: Copy the whole repository into this project: application code, pages, content, assets, database scripts, build config and documentation.
decisions.consequence: The project's own pinned TanStack Start/Router/Vite versions were kept (identical to the source), and the source's extra dependencies were merged in.

decisions.decision: The application database stays in the user's own Neon PostgreSQL with better-auth sessions; Lovable Cloud is not used for app data.
decisions.consequence: No data-layer rewrite. Reads and writes need the Neon connection plus its secrets before any live data flow works.

decisions.decision: Rebuild the offline schema record with the project's own script (bun scripts/schema-replay-snapshot.ts), because the committed db/schema.snapshot.json was stale against db/*.sql.
decisions.consequence: db/schema.snapshot.json and src/lib/db-types.gen.ts now match a replay of all 174 scripts; the schema replay test passes.

decisions.decision: Classify parent_authorizations (db/0174) as 'skip' in the account-merge allowlist: a merge is refused while an account owns a parental consent record.
decisions.consequence: Consent history is never silently moved or cascade-deleted by a merge. The user should confirm this is the rule they want; reassign or drop are the alternatives.

decisions.decision: Link the user's own Neon database as a workspace connector (gateway-backed) instead of pasting a connection string into the project.
decisions.consequence: The app reaches Neon through the connector gateway with NEON_API_KEY + LOVABLE_API_KEY; no connection string lives in app code. src/lib/neon.ts already selected the gateway transport, so no code change was needed.
